summary: Almonty Industries announced via Form 6-K the voluntary delisting of its common shares from the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX), effective July 31, 2026. The company cites low TSX trading volume relative to its Nasdaq listing and the costs of maintaining dual listings. No shareholder vote is required per TSX rules. Shares will continue trading on Nasdaq under symbol ALM. The delisting reduces administrative burdens while preserving a U.S. listing. Investors should watch trading liquidity shifts to Nasdaq, and Canadian holders must coordinate with brokers for Nasdaq access. No deal terms apply.
